note: METHOD: one background script queried all 68 composers: MusicBrainz (artist match on name and dates, then every work with its linked recordings), Deezer (album and artist search on the name, plus the surname alone) and Apple's composerTerm song search for every composer except Vidal B. (initial only); hits were opened through Deezer and Apple track lists, MusicBrainz releases, IMSLP work info (api.php) and a few web searches. 16 composers had a commercial recording in scope; 51 are 'triage: none found' (their pages are skipped as 'not performed or recorded (composer triage)'), Ximenez is 'partial': a Hungaroton guitar-trio disc turned up that could not be tied to the composer. ADDED, NOT ON IMSLP: Sterkel Piano Trio Op. 30 No. 2; Wagenseil's five sibling sonatas for three cellos and bass (Accent) and seven flute-violin-bass trios (CPO 555 406-2, numbered as on the disc, WV numbers unconfirmed); Weigl Trio No. 5; Toeschi's Flute Quartet Op. 2 No. 4 (Hoffmusic) and Zannetti's Trio Op. 2 No. 3 (The Vivaldi Project), both found through Apple's composerTerm search and attributed by Apple Music's classical pages; Tomasini's four string trios (Tactus); Anton Zimmermann's three Op. 3 quartets (Naxos); Witt's horn and bassoon quartets (CPO). MATCHING CALLS: Traversa's Quartetto Martinů disc is titled 'Six quatuors concertantes, Op. 4' but its tracks say 'Quatuors dialogués … Op. 4'; kept under the 'Quatuors concertants' page, the 'dialogués' page skipped (may be one work). Tomasini's Hungaroton disc has quartets in D, B-flat and D minor, two labelled Op. 8; all three kept as the set. Wendling Op. 10 No. 3 is labelled GUN 23 on Hoffmusic; Nos. 1-2 are matched to the Antes disc by key and movement plan. Tapray's recording does not state the instruments (kept as keyboard, violin, viola, cello with the print's alternatives). Storace's Sextet is the only Op. 2 work recorded. Keys given as 'B' in Deezer metadata (Wagenseil No. 5, Zimmermann No. 2) are taken as B-flat. Which Joseph Weigl wrote the oboe trios is not stated. WEAK 'none found' (initials, common or swamped names): Vidal B., Stout, Struck, Strunz, Uber A. and C. B., Valentine, Valois, Voigt, Walter, Walther, Wassermann, Karl Weiss, Weldon, Charles Wesley Jr., With, Wratny, Zeilinger. NOT ENTERED: Wagenseil's harp-concerto disc (Talitman: harp, 2 violins, cello) and the Antes disc's Terzetto in E-flat and D-major flute quartet (Wendling), which fit no page with certainty; the baryton trios of Tomasini (out of scope); the Leaf Music disc's keyboard works of Vogler. Computer-synthesised: Zappa (skipped). Christophorus CHE 0175-2 (Mozart's Pupils) also holds a C-major Divertimento for violin, viola and cello, a piano trio Op. 1/11 and a Concerto facile by Mozart's pupils (Süssmayr among them), composers per work not established: not entered.
